name: past_copula
description: English past-tense copula agreement: choose was or were from subject and past context; matched present-tense control.
generator_code:
import random,json
random.seed(0)
subjects=[('I','was','am'),('he','was','is'),('she','was','is'),('it','was','is'),('we','were','are'),('you','were','are'),('they','were','are'),('the child','was','is'),('the children','were','are'),('the teacher','was','is'),('the teachers','were','are'),('my friend','was','is'),('my friends','were','are'),('the dog','was','is'),('the dogs','were','are'),('the book','was','is'),('the books','were','are')]
preds=['ready','quiet','outside','at home','in the garden','near the door','very tired','happy','late','in the room']
combos=[(s,p) for s in subjects for p in preds];random.shuffle(combos)
items=[];control=[]
for (s,past,present),p in combos[:120]:
 items.append({'prompt':f'Complete the sentence with was or were. Yesterday, {s} ___ {p}.\nAnswer:','answer':' '+past})
 control.append({'prompt':f'Complete the sentence with am, is or are. Right now, {s} ___ {p}.\nAnswer:','answer':' '+present})
json.dump({'items':items,'control':control},open('/work/skill.json','w'))
